reviews.summary: HYPE has a confirmed team-token distribution scheduled for November 6, creating immediate supply/flow uncertainty. Large 8.6–9.9M HYPE calendar figures are tracker models, not verified distributions. ([binance.com](https://www.binance.com/en/square/post/10-28-2026-hyperliquid-labs-unlocked-180-000-hype-tokens-today-which-will-be-distributed-to-team-members-on-november-6th-382179985310070?utm_source=openai))
materialRisks: Hyperliquid Labs said 180,000 HYPE would be unlocked and distributed to team members on November 6; recipient selling/OTC handling is not disclosed. ([binance.com](https://www.binance.com/en/square/post/10-28-2026-hyperliquid-labs-unlocked-180-000-hype-tokens-today-which-will-be-distributed-to-team-members-on-november-6th-382179985310070?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: The signal is for HYPE, the native token of Hyperliquid; asset identity is unambiguous. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2078856/000119312526391097/d168095ds1.htm?utm_source=openai))

Monthly core-contributor vesting is an established supply mechanism continuing through 2027–2028. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2078856/000119312526391097/d168095ds1.htm?utm_source=openai))

Third-party unlock calendars show far larger November 6 amounts, but available reporting says those are modeled ceilings/schedules rather than a confirmed Hyperliquid distribution. ([app.blockworks.com](https://app.blockworks.com/projects/hyperliquid/token-unlocks?utm_source=openai))
